verdict.rationale: Cekura ingests call-level data through its observability send-calls endpoint (transcript, recording URL, metadata stored as a CallLog). It also documents 'enhanced observability' tracing for LiveKit agents via its SDK. However, nothing shows per-LLM-call traces with structured inputs, outputs, latency, or token usage. Its tracing is oriented around voice-call conversations rather than generic LLM call instrumentation. Missing for 10: per-LLM-call span capture, documented latency metrics, token usage tracking, instrumentation beyond LiveKit, and independent corroboration.
